1. Your first name
2. Your last name  
3. Your zip code

This will help me locate your account so I can assist you with your order.
Sure, yeah. Noah Ito. And my zip is 98187.

Perfect! I've found your account, Noah. Now I can help you with your order. 

What specific things do you need to sort out with your order? Are you looking to:

- Return or exchange items from a delivered order

If you can't locate the exact order ID, I can help you look up your recent orders to find the one with the watches. Just let me know when you're ready, and I can pull up your order history to help you identify the correct one.

Since I can't locate this specific order, let me try a different approach. Let me pull up your account details to see all your recent orders, and then we can identify the correct one with the watches.
